source: MAFF / ADB, "ដំណាំសណ្តែកសៀង" [Soybean crop], official cultivation manual, 2005
text: This 2005 MAFF/ADB manual opens with an introduction to soybean (សណ្តែកសៀង) as a major world and Cambodian oilseed/protein legume crop, presenting a nutritional-value table for the seed and discussing its place in Cambodian farming systems, including two broad seed-growth-habit types (determinate and indeterminate varieties) that the manual distinguishes through the rest of the text.
